title: Pay Commission Meeting Date Announced
summary: The 8th Pay Commission has announced a meeting in Delhi to discuss the new notification. The meeting is scheduled for August 7 and 10, with discussions on salary increments expected.
summary_points: The 8th Pay Commission has announced a meeting in Delhi.
The meeting is scheduled for August 7 and 10.
Discussions on salary increments are expected during the meeting.
The government has released a new notification regarding the pay commission.
The opposition has alleged that the government is trying to suppress dissent.

framing.center: Centrist coverage reported on the meeting date and the new notification, without a distinct frame.
framing.right: Right-leaning outlets emphasized the importance of the salary increments discussion, highlighting the foreign-donation angle and the demand for an audit.
